#en: Relax, Harper, we'll keep things civil! Trust me.
zh: 放心，哈珀，我们会规规矩矩的！相信我。

#en: Therefore, we best behave ourselves! Hah, don't worry, Harper. We know not to cause any trouble.
zh: 所以，我们最好安分点！哈，别担心，哈珀。我们知道不该惹麻烦。

#en: So, when Gren tells me -- he detects some sorta "Watchtower Listening Post" in the Altair system, I can't say I'm too happy about that!
zh: 所以，当格伦告诉我——他在牵牛星星系探测到某种"瞭望塔监听哨"时，我可说不上高兴！

#en: They seem like the domineering type. Sticking their noses where they're not wanted!
zh: 他们看着就是那种霸道类型。哪里不欢迎他们，就往哪里凑！

#en: Oh, yeah. That makes sense.
zh: 哦，对。有道理。

#en: I see. Good.
zh: 我明白了。很好。

#en: Hm. Noted.
zh: 嗯。记下了。

#en: Very good.
zh: 很好。

#en: Gren contacted us, let us know.
zh: 格伦联系了我们，让我们知道的。

#en: Yeah, take it off! Why not? Get some fresh air.
zh: 是啊，摘了吧！为什么不呢？透透气。

#en: About giving Watchtower a bloody lip...
zh: 关于让瞭望塔吃点苦头……

#en: Oh yeah! Now, compared to Torin and Gren, I've no real grudge with Watchtower. But from what little I know of 'em, I don't think I like 'em very much!
zh: 哦对！跟托林和格伦比，我跟瞭望塔没什么真正的仇。但就我了解的那么一点，我觉得我不太喜欢他们！

#en: [Skip Tutorial] A Fleet Command system, I understand.
zh: [跳过教程]舰队指挥系统，我明白。

#en: Good enough for me. Welcome to Stardock!
zh: 对我来说够了。欢迎来到星坞！

#en: I'll hold you to that. Anyway, welcome to Stardock.
zh: 我会记着你这句。总之，欢迎来到星坞。

#en: Hm, fair enough. In that case, welcome to Stardock!
zh: 嗯，说得有理。那这样的话，欢迎来到星坞！

#en: With that out of the way, welcome to Stardock! I... think that's what we ended up calling this place...
zh: 这事说开了，欢迎来到星坞！我……想我们最后是这么叫这地方的……

#en: Anyway, so long as you don't cause trouble, my docking bays are always open.
zh: 总之，只要你不惹麻烦，我的对接舱永远为你敞开。

#en: You better not! I got a long memory and no time for nonsense.
zh: 你最好别！我记性很长，也没工夫陪你胡闹。

#en: Yeah, yeah. I won't cause any trouble.
zh: 是，是。我不会惹麻烦的。

#en: Nevermind that, I just need to know if all this is still upgradable?
zh: 别说那个了，我只想知道这些东西还能升级吗？

#en: So I'd better behave myself!
zh: 所以我最好还是安分点！

#en: So-- Ah. Yeah... Did Torin prep you on this or something?
zh: 所以——啊。对……是托林提前跟你打过招呼还是怎么着？

#en: Yes, in theory. But I'd need specialized components. Watchtower Components.
zh: 是的，理论上可以。但我需要专门的组件。瞭望塔组件。

#en: Thanks Gren. And you could upgrade the Fleet Command system and Skydrops, right?
zh: 谢谢你，格伦。你能升级舰队指挥系统和空投，对吧？

#en: No need to keep the helmet on, Gren. I know it can be tough to talk in those things.
zh: 没必要一直戴着头盔，格伦。我知道戴着那东西说话挺难受的。

#en: Here's the recovered Control Node.
zh: 这是找回的控制节点。

#en: Go ahead, try it for yourself. Use the terminal and "Commission" one of your other ships to your fleet.
zh: 来吧，你自己试试。用终端把另一艘飞船"编入"你的舰队。

#en: This... "Fleet Command System" I've fabricated, you should find it fairly intuitive.
zh: 我制造的这套……"舰队指挥系统"，你应该会觉得挺直观。

#en: You told Torin about the Control Node? How'd you know where to find it?
zh: 你把控制节点的事告诉了托林？你怎么知道去哪儿找？

#en: Why did we need the Control Node?
zh: 我们为什么需要控制节点？

#en: [Repeat Tutorial] Could you show me how this "Fleet Command" system works?
zh: [重看教程]你能给我演示一下这套"舰队指挥"系统怎么用吗？

#en: [Repeat Tutorial] Could you show me how it all works?
zh: [重看教程]你能给我演示一下它怎么运作吗？

#en: Of course.
zh: 当然。

#en: [Skip Tutorial] Thanks. I'm sure I can figure it out myself.
zh: [跳过教程]谢谢。我相信自己能弄明白。

#en: If that's what you'd prefer.
zh: 如果你更愿意这样。

#en: Hm. It's in decent condition. Should be an easy install...
zh: 嗯。状况还不错。安装应该不难……

#en: Ah, glad to see you got it. I'll just install it...
zh: 啊，很高兴你拿到了。我这就安装……

#en: Huh, so you managed to get it. Good. Just give me a moment...
zh: 嗯，你居然搞到手了。很好。稍等片刻……

#en: It's a voluntary procedure, but one that's required to move up the ranks.
zh: 这是自愿的程序，但想晋升就必须要做。

#en: My appearance is a result of genetic manipulation. Something that most members of Watchtower are subjected to.
zh: 我的外貌是基因改造的结果。大多数瞭望塔成员都要接受这种改造。

#en: I did, indeed. And just so you know, I explained your whole ex-Watchtower situation, so take off the helmet already!
zh: 我确实说了。顺便告诉你，我已经把你曾是瞭望塔的身份解释清楚了，所以快把头盗摘了吧！

#en: You bet! Hey, it's fine if you show your face, you know? I've covered how you're former Watchtower.
zh: 当然！嘿，露个脸没关系，你知道吗？你曾是瞭望塔的事我已经说明过了。

#en: Yup, one of us now! No need to keep the helmet on, they know all about you being an ex-member of Watchtower.
zh: 对，现在是自己人了！没必要戴着头盔，他们都知道你曾是个瞭望塔成员。

#en: Better in our hands, than Watchtower's. Right? No reason to keep your helmet on, they know you're ex-Watchtower.
zh: 在我们手里总比在瞭望塔手里好。对吧？没必要戴着头盔，他们知道你曾是瞭望塔的人。

#en: Sure did! And I've already explained how you're ex-Watchtower, so no need to be shy, you can remove the helmet.
zh: 当然说了！而且我已经解释过你曾是瞭望塔的人，所以不用害羞，可以把头盔摘了。

#en: What makes you think Harper likes me?
zh: 你凭什么觉得哈珀喜欢我？

#en: We have the Control Node, should we go speak to Gren?
zh: 我们拿到控制节点了，该去找格伦谈谈吗？

#en: Haha! Alright, calm down. There's nothing to worry about.
zh: 哈哈！好了，冷静。没什么可担心的。

#en: You know what? Sounds like a great idea.
zh: 你知道吗？听起来是个好主意。

#en: Ah! Oh no! It's Watchtower, run away!
zh: 啊！哦不！是瞭望塔，快跑！

#en: There's no need to keep that helmet on.
zh: 没必要一直戴着那个头盔。

#en: Hm. I suppose not....
zh: 嗯。我想是吧……

#en: Oh. Ah, thank you.
zh: 哦。啊，谢谢。

#en: Hey, Gren. It's very nice to meet you.
zh: 嘿，格伦。很高兴见到你。

#en: Your choice! Lead, and I'll follow.
zh: 你决定！你带路，我跟着。

#en: Good to see you again, Harper.
zh: 很高兴又见到你，哈珀。

#en: Works for me!
zh: 我没意见！

#en: I'll defer to your judgment on this one!
zh: 这事我听你的判断！

#en: I'm right behind you!
zh: 我就在你后面！

#en: No argument here. Lead on!
zh: 我没意见。带路吧！

#en: You're the boss!
zh: 你说了算！

#en: Or, we could go see Harper! Let her know we've already taken care of that Listening Post.
zh: 或者，我们可以去见哈珀！让她知道我们已经处理了那个监听哨。

#en: Or, we could go see Harper! Let her tell us all about the Listening Posts and spy arrays.
zh: 或者，我们可以去见哈珀！让她给我们好好讲讲监听哨和间谍阵列。

#en: Hey, ixnay on the Unity talk-ay...
zh: 嘿，别念叨归一的事……

#en: No! First time. I just told 'em about you is all! Haha...
zh: 不！第一次。我就只是跟他们说了说你而已！哈哈……

#en: So far, it seems to be! I've not noticed any major differences yet. But, still early days.
zh: 目前看来是！我还没注意到什么重大差异。不过，还早着呢。

#en: We should give Gren the Control Node and talk with Harper.
zh: 我们该把控制节点交给格伦，并和哈珀谈谈。

#en: Is this Stardock the same as our last one?
zh: 这个星坞和我们上一个星坞一样吗？

#en: It's not something you should do casually. Especially with those who likely aren't ready for it. Harper, and Gren? They're not ready. Not yet.
zh: 这不是你该随便做的事。尤其是对那些很可能还没准备好的人。哈珀，还有格伦？他们还没准备好。还不行。

#en: If they don't just outright dismiss you, it can make them a target, completely upend their life, or even break their entire sense of reality!
zh: 如果他们不当场把你当成胡言乱语，这也会让他们成为目标，彻底颠覆他们的生活，甚至击碎他们对现实的整体认知！

#en: Have we not talked about this before? Anyway...
zh: 我们之前没聊过这个吗？总之……

#en: It can be dangerous to just come out and tell people you're from another universe. And not just dangerous for you, but for them as well!
zh: 直接告诉别人你来自另一个宇宙可能很危险。而且不只是对你有危险，对他们也是！

#en: Why can't we tell Harper and Gren about being Starborn?
zh: 我们为什么不能告诉哈珀和格伦星裔的事？

#en: Sounds like a plan to me! Just remember, you've never met him before.
zh: 我觉得这计划不错！只要记住，你从没见过他。

#en: Huh? ...Sorry, I don't think I know you. Have we met before?
zh: 嗯？……抱歉，我想我不认识你。我们见过吗？

#en: What's wrong with the station's power core?
zh: 空间站的动力核心出了什么问题？

#en: It's just rundown and outdated. It runs mostly fine enough, providing you keep an eye on it. So... Who are you again?
zh: 只是老旧过时了。只要盯着点，大体还算能用。那么……你又是谁？

#en: Oh, right! The one Watchtower is after...
zh: 哦，对！瞭望塔追的那个人……

#en: I don't care. You pick something.
zh: 我不介意。你挑一个吧。

#en: But considering she offered you free use of Stardock, that tells me she's put some trust in you. That's not something she does easily.
zh: 但考虑到她让你免费使用星坞，这说明她对你有些信任。这可不是她轻易会做的事。

#en: Besides that, usually, Harper's willing to give most folks a chance. However, she always keeps things... professional.
zh: 除此之外，通常哈珀愿意给大多数人一个机会。不过，她总是把事情办得……很职业。

#en: Well, she didn't have B.A.B.S. hurl you out of an airlock when you first met. That was my first clue.
zh: 嗯，你们初次见面时，她没让B.A.B.S.把你扔出气闸。那是我的第一条线索。

#en: I'll make sure she receives the necessary updates to assist you. Otherwise, I'll be here to help however I can.
zh: 我会确保她收到必要的信息更新，以便协助你。除此之外，我会在这里尽我所能提供帮助。

#en: If you need to restock any Skydrops, or require any other ship services, just check in with B.A.B.S.
zh: 如果你需要补充任何空投，或需要其他飞船服务，找B.A.B.S.就行。

#en: I'm the person Torin was looking for.
zh: 我就是托林在找的那个人。

#en: Until then, I can offer to outfit your ships with the Skydrops we already have. Assuming you have enough Watchtower Components.
zh: 在那之前，我可以把我们已有的空投装到你的飞船上。前提是你有足够的瞭望塔组件。

#en: Now, I didn't think you actually WOULD kill him, but it's good to know you can show restraint!
zh: 嗯，我没想到你真会杀他，但很高兴知道你能克制自己！

#en: ...Well, you know. He's got that whole... "Watchtower" thing going on.
zh: ……嗯，你知道。他带着那一整套……"瞭望塔"的做派。

#en: Well, the data you brought back didn't really have much value, at least to me. But I'm still happy that Listening Post is gone.
zh: 嗯，你带回来的数据其实没什么价值，至少对我而言。但我还是很高兴那个监听哨没了。

#en: Okay, onward to Gren!
zh: 好，去找格伦！

#en: Time to give Gren an update!
zh: 该给格伦更新情况了！

#en: Now that's done, let's go see Gren.
zh: 这事完了，我们去见格伦。

#en: Okay, let's go see Gren!
zh: 好，我们去见格伦！

#en: That went well! Let's check in with Gren.
zh: 进展不错！我们去找格伦。

#en: Time to clue Harper in.
zh: 该让哈珀知情了。

#en: Harper's next on the docket.
zh: 下一个是哈珀。

#en: Time to check in with Harper!
zh: 该去向哈珀报到了！

#en: Should follow Gren's advice, go talk with Harper.
zh: 该听格伦的建议，去和哈珀谈谈。

#en: Hah. Cool. More toys to play with! Gren made a good point though, we should go check in with Harper.
zh: 哈。酷。又有新玩具可以玩了！不过格伦说得有道理，我们该去找哈珀。

#en: We need to debrief Gren and Harper.
zh: 我们需要向格伦和哈珀汇报。

#en: Let's fill Harper and Gren in on our antics.
zh: 我们把我们的所作所为告诉哈珀和格伦吧。

#en: We'll need to get Gren and Harper up to speed. Who should we talk with first?
zh: 我们得让格伦和哈珀了解情况。先跟谁谈？

#en: Time to fill Harper and Gren in on what happened!
zh: 该把发生的事告诉哈珀和格伦了！

#en: Let's report in. Either Gren or Harper, order doesn't matter too much.
zh: 我们去汇报吧。格伦或哈珀，顺序不太重要。

#en: And maybe those guys will know what we can do with those "Computer Core" things we found.
zh: 也许那两位会知道我们能用找到的那些"计算机核心"做什么。

#en: We can either go fill Harper in on the details regarding the intel, or check in with Gren, pass on some of this Watchtower equipment we recovered.
zh: 我们要么去把情报的细节告诉哈珀，要么去找格伦，把我们回收的一些瞭望塔装备交给他。

#en: Phew! A lot sure happened out there...
zh: 呼！外面发生的事可真不少……

#en: Why would I kill Gren?
zh: 我为什么要杀格伦？

#en: You must make a decision. What Skydrop should we gain the ability to fabricate?
zh: 你必须做个决定。我们要获得制造哪种空投的能力？

#en: Ehh, don't worry, you didn't. Torin on the other hand...
zh: 呃，别担心，你没有。至于托林嘛……

#en: I'm sorry if we've caused you trouble.
zh: 如果我们给你添了麻烦，很抱歉。

#en: Oh. Um... yeah, hi. Nice to meet you too. Sorry, who are you...?
zh: 哦。呃……是，你好。也很高兴认识你。抱歉，你是……？

#en: Not injured, no. Not exactly... But, you have medical training? That could come in handy!
zh: 没受伤，没有。倒也不算……不过，你受过医疗训练？那可能派得上用场！

#en: Hello, nice to meet you.
zh: 你好，很高兴认识你。

#en: Surgeons? If someone's injured, maybe I can help.
zh: 外科医生？如果有人受伤，也许我能帮上忙。

#en: Someone else will have to take over the ship I was piloting. You should see to that as soon as you can.
zh: 得有人接手我驾驶的那艘飞船。你该尽快安排一下。

#en: I'll just hang out here at Stardock. If you need anything, me, Gren, Harper, we're here to help, alright?
zh: 我就待在星坞。如果你需要什么，我、格伦、哈珀，我们都在这儿帮忙，好吗？

#en: Fair enough! That's no problem.
zh: 有理！没问题。

#en: Actually, I'd rather we go our separate ways.
zh: 其实，我更希望我们各走各的。

#en: Don't you have other responsibilities?
zh: 你没有别的责任要担吗？

#en: Nope. Nothing tying me down! I am at your disposal.
zh: 没有。没什么拴得住我！我随你差遣。

#en: And no friends or family I need to worry about. Present company not included.
zh: 也没有需要牵挂的朋友或家人。在座的除外。

#en: What, you mean like... a job? I'm, uh, "between employment" right now. So that's not an issue!
zh: 什么，你是说……工作？我，呃，现在"处于待业状态"。所以那不是问题！

#en: Alright! Let's get going.
zh: 好！我们出发吧。

#en: Order me around, have me clean the toilets, put the fear of god in me. Whatever! It's your show. I'm just here to lend a hand.
zh: 随你差遣、让我刷马桶、让我怕你怕得不行。随便！这是你的舞台。我只是来搭把手的。

#en: Fantastic! Feel free to treat me as you would any other member of your crew!
zh: 太好了！就当我跟你其他船员一样对待我！

#en: Sure! It'll be good to stick together.
zh: 当然！待在一起是好事。

#en: But hey! We've got some of their tech figured out now. That's one step closer to turning the tables, right?
zh: 不过嘿！我们现在搞懂了他们的一些科技。离扭转局面又近了一步，对吧？

#en: No idea what constitutes the "right time". Maybe they're just waiting for the perfect moment to ruin our day.
zh: 不知道什么才算"合适的时机"。也许他们只是在等一个完美的时机来搅黄我们。

#en: Watchtower track, monitor, and when they think the time is right, spring an ambush.
zh: 瞭望塔追踪、监视，等他们觉得时机成熟，就发动伏击。

#en: But from what I can piece together, seems these Listening Posts are tuned to pick up... well, us!
zh: 但据我拼凑出来的，这些监听哨似乎是专门用来侦测……嗯，我们的！

#en: Sure looks that way. Of course, we still don't have the full picture...
zh: 看起来是。当然，我们仍没掌握全貌……

#en: So, the Listening Posts. That's how Watchtower tracks us?
zh: 那么，监听哨。瞭望塔就是这样追踪我们的？

#en: And honestly? Kinda hard to argue with the results so far!
zh: 而且说实话？目前的效果还真难反驳！

#en: But Gren seemed pretty confident there would be no issues. Said it's the best way to fight back! Use their own tricks against them.
zh: 但格伦似乎很有把握不会有问题。说这是最好的反击办法！以彼之道还施彼身。

#en: Huh, funny, I asked Gren the same thing. Y'know, are we just asking for trouble -- playing in their toybox, tinkering with their toys?
zh: 嗯，有意思，我也问过格伦同样的话。你知道，我们是不是在自找麻烦——在他们的玩具箱里玩，摆弄他们的玩具？

#en: Your doubts are reasonable, but unfounded. I've cut all ties with Watchtower. I won't turn on you, or Torin. Now...
zh: 你的疑虑合理，但没有根据。我已与瞭望塔断绝一切关系。我不会背叛你，或托林。那么……

#en: I'll only say this once. Don't cross me, Gren. If I find out you're still in league with Watchtower...
zh: 我只说一次。别骗我，格伦。如果我发现你还和瞭望塔有勾结……

#en: Is it wise to use Watchtower hardware against them?
zh: 用瞭望塔的硬件对付他们，明智吗？

#en: I've even heard of select personnel who are capable of "disintegration" so that they'll not leave traceable remains.
zh: 我甚至听说过有部分人员能"自解"，以免留下可追踪的遗骸。

#en: Data archives delete themselves. More valuable ships will often detonate, to leave salvage of little value.
zh: 数据归档会自行删除。较贵重的飞船往往会自爆，好让残骸毫无价值。

#en: Yes, most of their tech is designed to self-terminate. Though, each does so differently.
zh: 是的，他们大多数科技都设计成能自毁。不过方式各不相同。

#en: And if you don't mind the company, I think I'll stay on with you! You know, as an official part of your crew.
zh: 如果你不介意有人作伴，我想我就跟着你了！你知道，作为你船员的正式一员。

#en: And if you find yourself with some free time, you can always hunt down more Listening Posts! Or have Gren build and upgrade stuff for your fleet.
zh: 如果你有空闲时间，随时可以去猎杀更多监听哨！或者让格伦为你的舰队制造和升级装备。

#en: Watchtower are still a problem, but at least now you have a defence against them.
zh: 瞭望塔仍是个麻烦，但至少现在你有了防御他们的手段。

#en: I think for the time being, keep doing whatever it is you do.
zh: 我想眼下，你就继续做你该做的事吧。

#en: So what do you expect me to do now?
zh: 那你现在指望我做什么？

#en: Calls in a Model S "Shiva" bot to assist you. The Model S excels at close-quarters skirmishes and rapid response.
zh: 呼叫一台S型"湿婆"机器人前来协助你。S型擅长近距离遭遇战与快速反应。

#en: ...We found out how Watchtower's been tracking us. And even figured out how to exploit more of their technology against them!
zh: ……我们查出了瞭望塔是怎么追踪我们的。甚至还弄清了如何更多地利用他们的科技反制他们！

#en: Well, that was productive! You met with Gren, and didn't kill him. Harper seems to like you...
zh: 嗯，这趟挺有收获！你见了格伦，还没杀他。哈珀似乎挺喜欢你……

#en: Should you find more, consider bringing them to me. In the meantime, I'll resume my duties.
zh: 如果你找到更多，可以考虑带给我。在此期间，我会恢复我的职责。

#en: Feel free to bring me Cores like this, and I'll do what I can. For now, I'll get back to my tasks.
zh: 以后有这种核心尽管拿来，我会尽力而为。现在，我回去干活了。

#en: If you find more, bring them to me. For now, I should return to work.
zh: 如果你找到更多，拿来给我。现在，我该回去工作了。

#en: I'll return to my work. But I will be here -- if you need my services.
zh: 我回去干活了。但我会在这里——如果你需要我的服务。

#en: You said you'd found two Computer Cores, correct? I'd suggest you take one to Harper. I'm sure she'll have ideas on how to utilize it...
zh: 你说你找到了两个计算机核心，对吧？我建议你带一个给哈珀。我相信她会有办法利用它……

#en: Your skepticism is noted. Trust is earned. In time, I hope my actions speak louder than your doubts.
zh: 已记下你的怀疑。信任需要赢得。但愿随着时间推移，我的行动能比你的疑虑更有说服力。

#en: I'm still not sure I fully trust you, Gren...
zh: 我还是不太确定能完全信任你，格伦……

#en: Flexibility often provides advantage. I suggest you make use of what's at hand.
zh: 灵活往往带来优势。我建议你善用眼前的资源。

#en: Well, I suppose it's good to have options.
zh: 嗯，我想有得选总是好的。

#en: Gratitude is unnecessary. However... it is appreciated.
zh: 不必言谢。不过……我很感激。

#en: Deploys a kinetic-fire turret, which anchors swiftly and provides sustained ballistic support.
zh: 部署一座动能火力炮塔，能迅速固定并提供持续的弹道支援。

#en: Thanks a lot Gren, I appreciate you doing all this.
zh: 非常感谢你，格伦，谢谢你做的这一切。

#en: Give me an overview of the Ballistic Turret.
zh: 给我讲讲弹道炮塔的概况。

#en: And what would that be...?
zh: 那会是什么呢……？

#en: I'm afraid those are your only options.
zh: 恐怕你就只有这些选项了。

#en: I don't want any of these.
zh: 这些我都不要。

#en: The Surface Smoke Bomb seems the best option.
zh: 地表烟幕弹似乎是最好的选择。

#en: I'd prefer the Shiva Robot.
zh: 我更想要湿婆机器人。

#en: Okay, I've made a choice.
zh: 好，我选好了。

#en: Let's go with the Ballistic Turret.
zh: 就选弹道炮塔吧。

#en: Then I'd suggest we extract the data for the Shiva Robot.
zh: 那我建议我们提取湿婆机器人的数据。

#en: Blankets the area in dense smoke, obscuring vision and creating tactical cover for maneuvers or retreats.
zh: 以浓烟覆盖该区域，遮蔽视野，为机动或撤退提供战术掩护。

#en: Explain to me the Surface Smoke Bomb.
zh: 给我讲讲地表烟幕弹。

#en: With data mined from a sufficient number of cores, I could raise the number of vessels you can coordinate. As well as other adaptations.
zh: 从足够多的核心中挖掘数据后，我能提升你可协调的飞船数量。以及做出其他改进。

#en: Indeed. I believe the Fleet Command System can be expanded upon. For example...
zh: 确实。我相信舰队指挥系统还能进一步扩展。比如……

#en: You think we can upgrade the Fleet Command System?
zh: 你觉得我们能升级舰队指挥系统？

#en: We can upgrade the Fleet Command System?
zh: 我们能升级舰队指挥系统？

#en: What can you tell me about the Shiva Unit?
zh: 关于湿婆单元，你能告诉我什么？

#en: Does all Watchtower technology self-destruct?
zh: 所有瞭望塔科技都会自毁吗？

#en: So does all Watchtower technology self-destruct?
zh: 那么所有瞭望塔科技都会自毁吗？

#en: Even I find them difficult to fully comprehend.
zh: 就连我也觉得它们难以完全理解。

#en: Their design is also remarkably resistant to intrusion. Attempts to hack or decode them are next to impossible.
zh: 它们的设计还异常抗入侵。想黑入或解密它们几乎不可能。

#en: The cores employ a crystal substrate that maximizes capacity, pushing data storage -- far beyond traditional computing.
zh: 这些核心采用晶体基板以最大化容量，将数据存储——远远推离了传统计算的范畴。

#en: What can you tell me about Computer Cores?
zh: 关于计算机核心，你能告诉我什么？

#en: Tell me more about these Computer Cores.
zh: 再多讲讲这些计算机核心。

#en: In this way, even members within their ranks -- are shielded from information that could compromise the organization's security.
zh: 如此一来，即便组织内部的成员——也被隔绝在可能危及组织安全的信息之外。

#en: By utilizing purge protocols, Watchtower ensures that no individual can freely learn data they deem "sensitive".
zh: 通过启用清除协议，瞭望塔确保没有任何个人能随意获知他们视为"敏感"的数据。

#en: I would think that self-evident.
zh: 我以为这是不言而喻的。

#en: Hm. I suspect we can mine Computer Cores -- to acquire blueprints for new types of Skydrops. Or even devise upgrades for your Fleet Command System.
zh: 嗯。我猜我们可以从计算机核心中挖掘——以获取新型空投的图纸。甚至设计出对你舰队指挥系统的升级。

#en: I suspect we can mine Computer Cores -- to acquire blueprints for new types of Skydrops. Or even devise upgrades for your Fleet Command System.
zh: 我猜我们可以从计算机核心中挖掘——以获取新型空投的图纸。甚至设计出对你舰队指挥系统的升级。

#en: So you understand? I can only extract a limited subset of information from a core. Even so, this is still useful.
zh: 所以你明白了？我只能从核心中提取有限的一部分信息。即便如此，这也仍然有用。

#en: If you lack proper credentials, you can't read specific data -- without triggering a purge protocol. Erasing all other data from the device.
zh: 如果你没有适当的凭证，就无法读取特定数据——除非触发清除协议。那会把设备中的其他数据全部擦除。

#en: Good. So you already understand. I can only extract limited information from a core.
zh: 很好。看来你已经明白了。我只能从核心中提取有限的信息。

#en: See what you can get from this core.
zh: 看看你能从这个核心中弄到什么。

#en: Tell me, why does Watchtower tech have erasure protocols?
zh: 告诉我，瞭望塔的科技为什么会有擦除协议？

#en: Why does Watchtower tech have purge protocols?
zh: 瞭望塔的科技为什么会有清除协议？

#en: Our available choices are drops for either a Ballistic Turret, a Shiva Unit, or a Surface Smoke Bomb...
zh: 我们可选的空投有弹道炮塔、湿婆单元，或地表烟幕弹……

#en: Connection confirmed. Hm... I see data for three Skydrop schematics, yet we can only extract one.
zh: 连接已确认。嗯……我看到三份空投图纸的数据，但我们只能提取其中一份。

#en: One moment, I will establish a link to the Core.
zh: 请稍候，我将与核心建立连接。

#en: Although the data we can retrieve from them will be limited...
zh: 虽然我们能从中取回的数据会很有限……

#en: Oh, we already know all about them! Found two of 'em! A real wealth of information. At least until they erase themselves that is.
zh: 哦，我们早就了解了！找到了两个！信息量真不小。至少在它们自我擦除之前是这样。

#en: We know. Harper already explained! We can only pull small amounts of information before these sorta things wipe themselves.
zh: 我们知道。哈珀已经解释过了！这种东西自我擦除之前，我们只能提取少量信息。

#en: However, what you suggest is theoretically possible. But it would require construction materials and know-how we currently don't possess.
zh: 不过，你提出的在理论上可行。但那需要我们现在并不具备的建造材料和专业知识。

#en: When it comes to their components, Watchtower's construction methods are a mystery to me, and not something I could reverse-engineer.
zh: 说到他们的组件，瞭望塔的制造方法对我来说是个谜，也不是我能逆向破解的东西。

#en: I think there's a way to fabricate our own Watchtower Components.
zh: 我觉得有办法制造我们自己的瞭望塔组件。

#en: Is there no way to fabricate our own Watchtower Components?
zh: 难道没办法制造我们自己的瞭望塔组件吗？

#en: Despite being trained to work on their ships, I couldn't begin to explain how even half of their technology actually works.
zh: 尽管我受过维护他们飞船的训练，我也说不清他们哪怕一半的科技到底是怎么运作的。

#en: Their tech is simply too advanced, and often even defies conventional logic.
zh: 他们的科技就是太先进了，甚至常常违背常理。

#en: No, I can't. Not if I'm to replicate Watchtower-level hardware. Standard components just won't cut it.
zh: 不，不行。要复刻瞭望塔级别的硬件就不行。标准组件根本不够用。

#en: Can't you just use non-Watchtower components to build?
zh: 你就不能用非瞭望塔的组件来造吗？

#en: Can't you use non-Watchtower components to build things?
zh: 你不能用非瞭望塔的组件来制造东西吗？

#en: [Give Computer Core] We also recovered this, take a look...
zh: [交出计算机核心]我们还找回了这个，你看看……

#en: [Give Computer Core] I think you might find this interesting...
zh: [交出计算机核心]我想你也许会觉得这个有意思……

#en: [Give Computer Core] Also, we found these Computer Cores...
zh: [交出计算机核心]还有，我们找到了这些计算机核心……

#en: I've found some Watchtower hardware, can you use this?
zh: 我找到了些瞭望塔硬件，你能用上吗？

#en: Back already... Something wrong?
zh: 这就回来了……出什么事了？

#en: Well! I think we're done. Feel free to use Stardock for whatever you need! I think you've earned your spot here. Heh, I'll catch you later!
zh: 好了！我想我们完事了。星坞随你使用，需要什么尽管来！我想你在这里已经挣得了一席之地。嘿，回头见！

#en: You should bring that other Core to Gren! I'm sure he'll have something to say about it.
zh: 你该把另一个核心带给格伦！我相信他对此会有话说。

#en: A Watchtower Core... interesting. These often contain blueprints for Watchtower hardware. We could use these.
zh: 一个瞭望塔核心……有意思。这类东西往往含有瞭望塔硬件的图纸。我们能派上用场。

#en: You've found a Watchtower Computer Core. From these, I can extract data for upgrades or new Skydrops.
zh: 你找到了一个瞭望塔计算机核心。从这些里面，我能提取用于升级或新空投的数据。

#en: Is that... a Watchtower Computer Core...? Huh. With enough of these, I could pull blueprints to offer you upgrades, or even new Skydrops.
zh: 那是……一个瞭望塔计算机核心……？嗯。有足够多这种东西，我就能提取图纸，为你提供升级，甚至新空投。

#en: A Watchtower Computer Core... Huh. These units are exceedingly rare... Within them lie blueprints for Watchtower constructs. Things such as Skydrops.
zh: 一个瞭望塔计算机核心……嗯。这类单元极其罕见……其中含有瞭望塔造物的图纸。比如空投。

#en: Appreciate everything you've done. For this, far as I'm concerned, Stardock's your home too now. Door will always be open to you.
zh: 感谢你所做的一切。就此而言，对我来说，星坞现在也是你的家。大门永远为你敞开。

#en: Thanks for stepping up. You've more than earned the right to come and go as you like. Anytime you need it, you're welcome to call Stardock home.
zh: 谢谢你挺身而出。你早已赢得自由往来的权利。任何时候你需要，都可以把星坞当作你的家。

#en: Thanks for your help! Feel free to come and go as you please, Stardock's doors will always be open to you.
zh: 谢谢你的帮助！随时自由往来，星坞的大门永远为你敞开。

#en: Uh... This hardware's a little beyond my skill to crack. But leave it with me! I know someone who might be able to get something useful from it.
zh: 呃……这硬件有点超出我的破解能力。但交给我吧！我认识一个人，也许能从中弄出些有用的东西。

#en: Seen this kind of tech before, Gren's got a few. Bit above my paygrade, but let me hold onto it. Got some ideas...
zh: 见过这种科技，格伦那儿有几个。有点超出我的水平，但让我留着它。我有些想法……

#en: Gren showed me one of these. This sorta hardware's a bit outta my league... But give me time to make some calls. I might know someone...
zh: 格伦给我看过一个。这种硬件有点超出我的能力……但给我点时间打几个电话。我可能认识人……

#en: Yeah, I've seen these, Gren has some broken ones. But, I think this hardware's a little beyond my skill. Leave it with me though, I got some ideas...
zh: 是啊，我见过这些，格伦有几个坏的。不过，我觉得这硬件有点超出我的能力。但交给我吧，我有些想法……

#en: They work kinda like the Intel Slates, wiping itself after you pull data from it.
zh: 它们的运作有点像情报数据板，你提取数据后它就会自擦。

#en: ...Right, yeah. I've seen one of these in Gren's workshop. He explained what it was.
zh: ……对，是啊。我在格伦的工坊里见过一个。他解释过那是什么。

#en: But like the Intel Slates, without the proper credentials, you can only pull a small amount of data before it wipes everything else.
zh: 但和情报数据板一样，没有适当的凭证，你只能提取少量数据，然后它就会擦掉其余一切。

#en: ...You don't say. I think I've seen one of these in Gren's workshop. They store data on Watchtower schematics. It's how he built you those Skydrops.
zh: ……是吗。我想我在格伦的工坊里见过一个。它们储存关于瞭望塔构造图的数据。他就是这么做出来那些空投给你的。

#en: Yeah, we found two of them. Pretty weird, huh?
zh: 是啊，我们找到了两个。挺怪的，是吧？

#en: Yeah, found two of 'em! Already gave one to Gren. They hold data on how to build Watchtower tech, apparently!
zh: 是啊，找到了两个！已经给格伦一个了。看来它们存有建造瞭望塔科技的数据！

#en: Yeah, found two of 'em! No idea what they're for though.
zh: 是啊，找到了两个！不过不知道是干什么用的。

#en: Yeah, found two of 'em! Already gave one to Gren. Apparently they hold data on how to build Watchtower tech.
zh: 是啊，找到了两个！已经给格伦一个了。据说它们存有建造瞭望塔科技的数据。

#en: And now, you got one less system that's on their radar. No more surprise attacks there!
zh: 而现在，你好歹少了一个在他们雷达上的星系。那儿不会再有突然袭击了！

#en: The best part is: knock out a Post and its Array -- and it stops feeding intel back to Watchtower. Not to mention, you can grab some intel for yourself.
zh: 最妙的是：端掉一个哨站及其阵列——它就不再向瞭望塔回传情报了。更别说你还能给自己弄到些情报。

#en: Difference is, you're the one picking the fight. Now it's on your terms. You know when and where it's comin'.
zh: 不同之处在于，是你挑起了这场仗。现在按你的条件来。你知道它何时何地会来。

#en: You're not wrong. Tamper with their tech, and you're basically jingling keys right in their face. Watchtower's gonna react.
zh: 你说得没错。动他们的科技，基本上就是在他们脸前晃钥匙。瞭望塔会有反应的。

#en: But if I attack Listening Posts and Arrays, Watchtower will attack.
zh: 但如果我攻击监听哨和阵列，瞭望塔就会反击。

#en: If you don't take out their Listening Posts, then it's just a waiting game.
zh: 如果你不除掉他们的监听哨，那就只是坐等。

#en: You'll light up their scanners each time you enter a system. And once you hit a threshold, Watchtower will send in a fleet to try and grab you.
zh: 你每次进入一个星系都会点亮他们的扫描器。一旦达到某个阈值，瞭望塔就会派舰队来抓你。

#en: If you keep cruising around surveilled territory, then yeah, you can count on more ambushes.
zh: 如果你继续在被监视的地盘上晃悠，那么是的，你可以期待更多伏击。

#en: So if I do nothing, I can expect more Watchtower ambushes?
zh: 所以如果我什么都不做，就会遇到更多瞭望塔伏击？

#en: Eh, who knows! Maybe you're onto something. Just don't get too cocky, alright?
zh: 呃，谁知道呢！也许你说到了点子上。只是别太得意，行吗？

#en: But, when I think about it... I doubt Watchtower is used to being hunted. Usually, it would be the other way around.
zh: 不过，仔细想想……我不觉得瞭望塔习惯被人猎杀。通常，反过来的才是常态。

#en: ...What, you do that kinda thing for a living or something? Tch... I dunno, seems like asking for trouble to me.
zh: ……怎么，你是靠干这个谋生的还是什么？啧……我不知道，在我看来像是在自找麻烦。

#en: I already have a few ideas on how to turn the tables on Watchtower.
zh: 我已经有几个扭转对瞭望塔局面的主意了。

#en: [Give Computer Core] One more thing, we recovered a Computer Core. It stores data on Watchtower schematics...
zh: [交出计算机核心]还有一件事，我们找回了一个计算机核心。它储存着瞭望塔构造图的数据……

#en: [Give Computer Core] Before we go, you might want to see this Watchtower Computer Core...
zh: [交出计算机核心]走之前，你也许想看看这个瞭望塔计算机核心……

#en: [Give Computer Core] One last thing, we found these Watchtower Computer Cores...
zh: [交出计算机核心]最后一件事，我们找到了这些瞭望塔计算机核心……

#en: But, whatever. Bring me more Intel Slates, and I'll do what I can to help.
zh: 不过，算了。多带些情报数据板给我，我会尽力帮忙。

#en: Yeah, I suppose. Up to you if you wanna keep taking down Listening Posts. Just be ready for a Watchtower fleet to jump in and attack you.
zh: 嗯，我想是吧。你想继续端掉监听哨由你决定。只是要做好瞭望塔舰队跃迁进来攻击你的准备。

#en: That's right, but! Any system we clear of a Listening Post -- means Watchtower can't track us there!
zh: 没错，但是！我们清除了监听哨的任何一个星系——都意味着瞭望塔无法在那里追踪我们！

#en: Ah! But any system we clear of them, means Watchtower can't track us there!
zh: 啊！但只要是我们清除了它们的星系，瞭望塔就无法在那里追踪我们！

#en: Watchtower really is hunting you. These Listening Posts, any system that has one, makes you vulnerable to ambush.
zh: 瞭望塔确实在猎捕你。这些监听哨，任何有监听哨的星系，都会让你容易遭到伏击。
